ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central axis and peduncle interface are solid low-intensity black. Large, irregular high-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the mid-to-lower sections of both lateral lobes, containing high-density black stippling and mottling towards the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, moderate-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with particularly jagged topography at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) are concentrated at both distal tips and scattered across the central dark region near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-colored, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible diagonally across the high-intensity white areas of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the extreme lateral tips and proximal to the median notch; visible linear scarring on the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black stippling pattern concentrated in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white zone.
